# Khairul Islam Kakon — Software Engineer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Khairul Islam Kakon, a Dhaka-based software engineer working with React, Next.js, Laravel and Node.js. The site is a single-page app with sections for experience, projects, skills, education, about and contact.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio home](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/): Hero, key numbers, career and GitHub activity charts.
- [Experience](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/#section-experience): Work history across companies.
- [Projects](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/#section-projects): Live project showcase.
- [Skills](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/#section-skills): Technology stack and tools.
- [Education](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/#section-education): CSE degree at AIUB.
- [Contact](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/#section-contact): Ways to reach Khairul.

## Resources

- [CV (PDF)](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/khairul_islam_kakon_CV.pdf): Current curriculum vitae.
- [Sitemap](https://kikportfolio.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for crawlers.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/kik-work): Source code and open projects.
